final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client) AS share FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), above_average AS (SELECT client_count, share FROM region_counts WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_counts)) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_client_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_counts)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
